h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers & Suppliers in Jammu And Kashmir

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers & Suppliers in Jammu And Kashmir

items.pText: Jammu and Kashmir asks more of outdoor play equipment than most of India. Jammu and the plains around it get hot summers, while the Kashmir valley has snow for weeks in winter and frozen ground for longer. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures playground equipment that handles both, using galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic that do not rust or crack in wet cold.

Our factory is in Vasai, near Mumbai, about 1,640 km away by road. We dispatch the finished equipment by truck, and our installation team or a dealer in north India installs it, self-standing or grouted. Buyers in the region are mostly schools, municipal parks, hotels and resorts in Srinagar and the hill stations, and government departments. Share the site size, the age group of the children and a few photos, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning around snow and the installation season

c: In the valley, grouting and concrete work are hard once the ground freezes, so plan installation for the months between spring and late autumn. Order early in the year if you want the play area ready for summer visitors. Snow sliding off slides and roofs is heavy, so clear it from decks and keep children off the equipment until it is dry. Check bolts and swing hangers after each winter.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can playground equipment stay outdoors through a Kashmir winter?
items.a: Yes. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are weather-proof. Clear heavy snow from decks, keep children off wet or icy surfaces, and check fittings when the snow melts.

items.q: When should we install a playground in the valley?
items.a: Between spring and late autumn, when the ground is not frozen and grouting can set properly. In Jammu, installation is possible for most of the year outside the heaviest monsoon rain.

items.q: Do you deliver equipment all the way to Jammu and Kashmir?
items.a: Yes. We send it by road from our Vasai factory, about 1,640 km away, and install it with our own team or a dealer in the north.
